model_family: Source-conditioned stratified marginal sampling with a Gaussian random-intercept rank copula and outcome-independent correlated missingness

evidence_use.operator: per-visit arithmetic mean, sample SD, nonmissing count
evidence_use.population: 75 adults with overweight or obesity; 12-week internet behavioral weight-management program, then 9 months without additional intervention; measurements at months 0,3,6,9,12.
evidence_use.measurement: Clinic weight in kg; PFS total average of 15 1-5 items; No-Go errors integer; delay-discounting AUC separately for $100 and $1000 conditions.
evidence_use.provenance: source_packet_A; supplied target-derived marginals, reconstruction regime A0
evidence_use.reason: Use all 25 outcome-visit means and sample SDs to parameterize marginal distributions, and all 25 nonmissing counts exactly at n=75. Stratified quantiles stabilize finite-sample margins. These target-derived summaries are construction inputs, not independent validation. Marginal shapes, all joint associations, and individual missingness remain unidentified. Moment estimates are used as distribution parameters; exact finite-sample moment equality is not claimed.

evidence_use.population: 75 adults with overweight or obesity; 12-week internet behavioral weight-management program, then 9 months without additional intervention; measurements at months 0,3,6,9,12.
evidence_use.measurement: Clinic weight in kg; PFS total average of 15 1-5 items; No-Go errors integer; delay-discounting AUC separately for $100 and $1000 conditions.
evidence_use.reason: Generate five visits per new synthetic person, positive weight, a baseline-only weight limit of 180 kg, PFS on the 1/15 measurement lattice within 1-5, integer No-Go errors within 0-512, and discounting AUC in 0-1. Eligibility describes the intended population; age, BMI, pregnancy and contraindications cannot be represented or verified because their component measurements are outside this bounded schema.

components.name: outcome-specific marginal distributions
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Same-population A0 reconstruction. Weight uses a lognormal distribution with baseline upper truncation; PFS uses a scaled beta rounded to a 1/15 lattice; No-Go errors use an overdispersed negative binomial truncated at 512; each discounting condition uses beta margins. Sample SDs parameterize distribution SDs before truncation/rounding. Each observed margin has independently jittered stratified quantiles assigned according to latent ranks. These choices favor valid support and source-compatible moments but assume unreported distribution shapes and suppress unconditional sampling variation of the margins.

components.name: longitudinal rank dependence
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Gaussian random-intercept latent repeatabilities are 0.94 for weight, 0.60 for PFS, 0.50 for No-Go errors, and 0.65 for both discounting conditions. Their directions and magnitudes are working assumptions, not source measurements. Discounting person factors correlate 0.70 and discounting same-visit occasion factors correlate 0.50. Other domain factors are independent as a parsimonious working restriction, not because absent evidence means a true zero correlation. Observed correlations differ from latent parameters after transformations, ranks, and missingness. No individual treatment-response factor or causal effect is inferred.

components.name: exact marginal missingness with shared attendance
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Each outcome-visit nonmissing count is round(source observed count times n/75). Select observations by latent availability ranks independent of all outcome factors. Availability-score variance fractions are 0.60 persistent person, 0.30 shared visit, and 0.10 endpoint-specific. This permits strongly overlapping missingness and intermittent return without forcing permanent dropout. Missingness-outcome independence, overlap and persistence are unreported assumptions, and observed-margin stratification does not recover individual missingness mechanisms.

scenarios.assumption: One support-respecting reconstruction with persistent outcome ranks, a shared discounting domain, independent weight/PFS/No-Go domains, and outcome-independent correlated missingness. The chosen dependence is provisional and uncalibrated to any reserved result.
scenarios.inclusion_rationale: Retain the parent as the single committed working model. Supplied source feedback reports valid support, exact missing counts and 25/25 marginal envelopes at each of the three prescribed seeds. No cross-endpoint, longitudinal or missingness-overlap evidence identifies a better joint structure. Changing a numerical dependence parameter merely to obtain a different analysis would be unsupported. The same-person visit design motivates persistence as a working assumption but does not identify its magnitude or direction; common discounting measurement likewise does not establish its correlation. This no-op preserves transparent assumptions rather than treating compatibility as proof. The twenty-cohort allocation is computational, not a posterior probability.

changes_from_parent.reason: Allowed source diagnostics show no contract or marginal-envelope failure. The evidence identifies univariate reconstruction targets but provides no basis to select a different dependence or missingness mechanism. Marginal shape alternatives are also unidentified. A numerical improvement in already close supplied margins would not establish improved target inference.

source_check_results.scope: Source-only construction diagnostics; no reserved target evaluation.
source_check_results.n_generalization: Static review only: per-visit observed counts scale as round(source_n_observed * n / evidence.n_persons), with n new keys and five visits. No additional cohort sizes were generated.
source_check_results.interpretation: Means and SDs are reconstruction inputs. Source-envelope agreement does not validate distribution shapes, covariance, regression effects, coverage or missingness mechanisms. Controller may attach checks of the same retained structure/seed cohorts.

examined_structures.reason: The one examined structure passes supplied source diagnostics; no evidence identifies an improvement to the unreported joint distribution. Retain its fully disclosed provisional dependence and support-respecting marginal families.

calibration_log.alternative_search: No alternative executable structure was examined or generated. No direction, coefficient, p value, interval or target outcome was accessed or used for selection.

inherited_feedback.interpretation: Allowed existing parent feedback only; not new branch diagnostic calls.

administrative_notes: Only REQUEST.md and its exact file allowlist were inspected. No outside provenance, reference records, reserved results, web sources, sibling runs or controller were used.
Some long allowed-file read displays were truncated; targeted reads and compact summaries recovered the required content. These display truncations were not generation failures.
Only generator.py and decision.json are written; Python runs with -B to avoid bytecode files.
